name: Question 15
worked_solution:
First, we find the cumulative probability using symmetry:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-2.7<X<2.7) & =0.4108 \\ 2P(0<X<2.7) & =0.4108 \\ P(0<X<2.7) & =0.2054 \\ P(X<2.7)-P(X<0) & =0.2054 \\ P(X<2.7)-0.5 & =0.2054 \\ P(X<2.7) & =0.7054 \\ P(X\le 2.7) & =0.7054\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 2.7) & =0.7054 \\ P(Z\le \frac{2.7-0}{\sigma }) & =0.7054 \\ Φ(\frac{2.7}{\sigma }) & =0.7054 \\ \frac{2.7}{\sigma } & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.7054)\end{aligned}
$$

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(0.54)=0.7054\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.7054)=0.54.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2.7}{\sigma } & =0.54 \\ \sigma  & =\frac{2.7}{0.54} \\ \sigma  & =5\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

First, we find the cumulative probability using symmetry:

P(−2.7<X<2.7)=0.41082P(0<X<2.7)=0.4108P(0<X<2.7)=0.2054P(X<2.7)−P(X<0)=0.2054P(X<2.7)−0.5=0.2054P(X<2.7)=0.7054P(X≤2.7)=0.7054

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by z-scoring:

P(X≤2.7)=0.7054P(Z≤2.7−0σ)=0.7054Φ(2.7σ)=0.70542.7σ=Φ−1(0.7054)

According to the table, we have

Φ(0.54)=0.7054⇒Φ−1(0.7054)=0.54.

Therefore, we have

2.7σ=0.54σ=2.70.54σ=5
